description: Offline planning sweep over completed triage runs. Pass A deterministically groups every false-positive verdict by AriadneFaultArea (derive_fault_area); Pass B dispatches one plan-strategist (opus) per fault-area bucket to design a hierarchical fix-plan tree; Pass C reconciles within the task-DB by dedup_key and writes PlanTask rows + a per-sweep event log to ~/.ariadne/plan/. Planning-only: never writes backlog/, registry.json, or packages/core. Graduation to backlog/ is the user-invoked export adapter.

flows.name: Triage false-positives → grouped hierarchical plan tree
flows.description: Triage false-positives → grouped hierarchical plan tree
intentions: Write boundary: the plan engine never writes backlog/, registry.json, or packages/core — it writes only the task-DB under ~/.ariadne/plan/.
Augment, not duplicate: a re-sweep of the same runs reconciles into existing PlanTask rows by dedup_key rather than minting duplicates.
Partial-sweep safety: a sweep interrupted partway leaves the task-DB consistent — no orphaned or half-written rows.
Permanent-never-exported: a permanent-limitation row never graduates to backlog/; its durable deliverable is a registry classifier.

stores.semantic_role: the plan task-DB: one PlanTask row per file (architectural -> fault_area -> localized tier). The plan engine is the single autonomous writer via JsonPlanTaskRepository.put_many; reconciled in-DB by dedup_key (augment). status flips to exported are owned by the export adapter (190.22.11).
append-only PlanSweepEvent log, one .jsonl per sweep (create/augment/supersede/combine/export). Written via JsonPlanTaskRepository.append_sweep_event; the audit trail of each reconciliation decision.

per-sweep scratch: Pass A writes one FaultAreaBucket per area under buckets/; the plan-strategist writes one StrategistPlan per bucket under plans/; Pass C reads both. Distinct from the canonical tasks/ + sweeps/ surfaces.

read-only dedup signal wired into Pass C reconcile (src/store/backlog_dedup.ts via reconcile_plan.ts), keyed on the `plan_dedup_keys` frontmatter export_to_backlog.ts stamps. WRITE BOUNDARY: never written by this skill; graduation is the user-invoked export adapter.

sub_agents.multiplicity: one per fault-area bucket from Pass A; dispatcher bounds concurrency to 5. Each emits a StrategistPlan (hierarchical fix-plan tree), not a classifier spec; for each 'other' bucket it emits BOTH a taxonomy-extension task and an underlying-core-fix task.
